title: Meta +3.4% in a tech rout as Amazon weighs letting Muse back in
story: Meta rose 3.4% while tech sank, because Fortune reported Amazon is in talks to let Meta's AI shopper Muse back onto its store, two months after blocking it.
structure: escalation -> rehook -> open loop (blocked, talks, sign-off)

post.caption:
Meta stock rose 3.4% on Wednesday while the Nasdaq sank as much as 4.6% in the morning.
The reason: Fortune reported that Amazon and Meta are in talks to let Muse, Meta's AI shopping agent, back onto Amazon, two months after Amazon blocked it. The sticking point is ads: Muse shops without seeing them, and ads earn Amazon $68.6 billion a year.
Any deal needs both CEOs to sign off, and no date is set. Meta still sits about 22% below its September record.

The full why, with charts, lands Sunday for members → link in bio.

#meta #metastock #amazon #aishopping #techstocks

Sources: Fortune via The Next Web (Nov 25), The Company Chronicle (Nov 25), Parameter (Nov 25), JournalArta (Nov 25), Stocktwits via Yahoo Finance (Nov 25). Not investment advice.
